title: "The fourth page manifests"
next_chapter_hook: "When the words 'Apart from breaking the shackles and becoming a new Heavenly Dao, there is a third path' met his eyes, Chen Ji realized for the first time that fate did not have only black-and-white answers—but what exactly was that path?"

text.content: "Deep within the secret passage, fine water droplets condensed on the damp stone walls, refracting the light from the fragment in Chen Ji's hand into countless shards. He stared at the faint mark on the edge of the fragment—it was the one his sister Chen Nian had carved with a pebble when she was seven years old, a crooked little bird. Ten years had passed, the lines worn nearly invisible by time, yet now they glowed with a faint radiance. 'The key to the fourth page, the Tianji Pavilion and the Eye of Heavenly Dao are both searching for it...' he murmured, repeating the Observer's words, his fingertip unconsciously stroking over the little bird design. The aura of the Tianji Record began to stir, as if responding to some long-forgotten call. Chen Ji's brow furrowed—the reaction was wrong, the fragment had never resonated with any external object before."

dialogue.content: "'Found it... her mark, I finally found it.' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul rose from the fragment, his voice carrying a rare tremor. 'Chen Ji, when your sister carved this mark all those years ago, it was no accident—she was instinctively marking the entrance to the fourth page. Quickly, press the fragment against the mark!'"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not act immediately. He stared at Mo Xiansheng's illusory face, his gaze cooling several degrees: 'You knew there was an entrance here all along, yet you only mentioned it now?' Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, his remnant soul's form dimming slightly: 'The timing wasn't right. Opening it by force would only let the Eye of Heavenly Dao capture the fourth page's contents... Now it's different, that Observer has already exposed the fourth page's existence. Keeping it hidden any longer would only draw more forces here.' The words sounded reasonable, but the thorn in Chen Ji's heart remained embedded. He made a mental note—when this matter was settled, some accounts would need to be settled slowly."

"Regardless of the twists and turns in his heart, the opportunity before him could not be missed. Chen Ji took a deep breath, slowly pressing the fragment against the little bird mark on the stone wall. The moment the fragment touched the mark, a blinding golden light exploded from the point of contact, illuminating the entire secret passage bright as daylight. Chen Ji instinctively closed his eyes, yet he felt a warm force flow from the fragment into his palm, rushing along his meridians straight to his mind—a difficult-to-describe sense of tugging, as if some long-sealed memories were trying to break free. His sister, the girl taken by the Holy Sect when she disappeared, what had she left behind in the Tianji Record?"

dialogue.content: "'Brother...' A faint whisper sounded in his ear, Chen Nian's voice, childlike yet carrying a worldly weariness unfitting for a child: 'The fourth page... it's been waiting for you... don't let them... don't let them...' The voice cut off abruptly, as if severed by some force."

text.content: "The golden light gradually收敛, condensing into a虚幻的书页悬浮在陈机面前。"

The golden light gradually收敛, condensing into a virtual page suspended before Chen Ji. The fourth page had finally manifested. Chen Ji stared fixedly at the golden text flowing across that page, his heart pounding like a war drum. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted to his side, equally transfixed by those lines of text. In the secret passage, silence was so profound one could hear water droplets falling from the stone walls. Chen Ji's breathing stood out starkly in that stillness. He had a premonition—the things written on this page would completely transform his understanding of this world. The Eye of Heavenly Dao, the Tianji Pavilion, the ten-thousand-year chess game... perhaps all the mysteries were hidden within this single thin page."

"The fourth page slowly unfolded, golden characters dancing like living things before finally settling into a passage of soul-shaking words. Chen Ji read through them word by word, his complexion shifting from pallor to ashen gray, then to an indescribable complexity. 'All past prophets have been mere chess pieces...' he murmured aloud, each word a hammer strike to his heart. 'The destined fate of the Tianji Record's host has three possibilities: First, being devoured by the Eye of Heavenly Dao, becoming part of Heavenly Dao; Second, rebelling against the Tianji Record, reverse-invading it to become the new Heavenly Dao will; Third...' His voice abruptly rose. 'Third, becoming the key to initiate the ultimate chess game—using oneself as the price to open the passage connecting all heavens.'"

"Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently, golden light flickering uncertainly. 'So that's how it was... so that's how it was...' he murmured. 'The Tianji Record was never a prophetic divine artifact, it was a key from the very beginning! The reason past hosts went mad or died wasn't because they revealed too many heavenly secrets, but because the Eye of Heavenly Dao wouldn't allow chess pieces to jump off the board!' Chen Ji didn't respond, his gaze locked on the final line of text, which read: 'Chen Ji, an existence beyond the opposition between the Tianji Pavilion and the Eye of Heavenly Dao, represents the fourth possibility—'"

dialogue.content: "Before the words could finish being read, the characters on the fourth page suddenly twisted violently. A terrifying aura descended from the void, pressing down on Chen Ji until he could barely breathe—it was the gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Dao! He instantly understood: the fourth page's content had touched forbidden truths that should not have been窥探, alerting the ultimate existence. Mo Xiansheng shouted sharply: 'Quick! Focus your spirit, command the fragment to close! Your very existence is a threat to it—it wants to erase you right now!' Chen Ji gritted his teeth, veins bulging on his forehead, desperately pouring his consciousness into the fragment. The characters on the fragment flashed wildly, that unfinished sentence seeming to have some force desperately preventing it from manifesting—'is the fourth possibility—'"

text.content: "A cold voice rang out from all directions, devoid of any emotion yet making Chen Ji's soul tremble: 'Insignificant creature... you dared to窥探 truths you were not meant to know.' Chen Ji felt an invisible force grip his throat, his vision beginning to blur. He heard his own rasping voice: 'He... the Eye of Heavenly Dao...' That voice seemed to laugh, laughter full of mockery and disdain: 'You think your little cleverness could escape my sight? From the day you obtained the Tianji Record, you have been a piece on my chessboard.'"

"Chen Ji's consciousness struggled frantically at the edge of collapse. He could feel the Eye of Heavenly Dao's power infiltrating his Mental Sea, intending to crush everything in him into nothingness. But at this critical moment, the final line of text on the fragment erupted with intense golden light—'is the fourth possibility—breaking the shackles and becoming a new Heavenly Dao, there exists a third path.' The golden light formed a barrier, temporarily isolating the Eye of Heavenly Dao's power. Chen Ji seized the moment to forcefully open his eyes, gasping for air, his face deathly pale. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted weakly nearby, its golden light much dimmer: 'Fortunately... the final sentence manifested... Heaven never closes all doors...'"

choice.prompt: "Chen Ji forced himself to stand steady, his mind racing. The third path... the fourth possibility beyond breaking shackles and becoming new Heavenly Dao... what did this mean? The Eye of Heavenly Dao wasn't the endgame, and hosts of the Tianji Record didn't necessarily have to become its puppets or rebel against it... So what exactly was this third path? His gaze fell on the fourth page again, only to find those golden characters gradually fading away, as if everything just now had merely been an illusion. Only the little bird mark on the fragment still flickered with a faint glow, as if to remind him all of this was real. How much did his sister Chen Nian know? Had the mark she left been coincidence or deliberate design?"

choices.text: "Chen Ji closed his eyes, sinking his consciousness into the fragment. The sensation of Heavenly Fate draining away came again, as if something was being extracted from within him. He saw a blurred image—Chen Nian standing in chaos, golden chains coiling around her body, repeatedly uttering the same phrase: 'The key isn't in the book, the key is in me...' The image cut off abruptly, Chen Ji's eyes snapping open, his pupils reflecting the fragment's faint light. His sister indeed knew the key to the third path."

choices.text: "Chen Ji tucked the fragment into his chest, cast one final look at the little bird mark slowly dimming on the stone wall, then turned toward the secret passage's exit. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's threat loomed close, but he wouldn't be foolish enough to expose more trump cards under its observation. The chess game had just begun, he had plenty of time to slowly set his pieces. Yet at this moment, an unprecedented urgency surged in his heart—Chen Nian was in the Holy Sect's hands, she knew the third path, and both the Tianji Pavilion and the Eye of Heavenly Dao were searching for that key... This ten-thousand-year chess game was far more complex than he had imagined."
choices.description: "Proactively transmit information to the Eye of Heavenly Dao, testing its bottom line"
choices.visible_cost: "Boldly declare his existence to that gaze, attempting to infer more information about the third path from the Eye of Heavenly Dao's reactions."
choices.risk_hint: "Obtain clues about the Eye of Heavenly Dao's weaknesses"

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath, addressing the void loudly: 'I know you're watching. You don't dare directly erase me because I possess the variable of the fourth possibility—your chessboard cannot contain this piece of mine.' Silence. Endless silence. When that cold voice sounded again, Chen Ji detected a barely perceptible fluctuation within it: 'Interesting... but do you think knowing these things can change anything? Throughout the ages, 'variables' like you have appeared no fewer than ten times.' Chen Ji pressed further: 'And then?' The voice offered no response, as if it had never existed. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded in his ear: 'It didn't deny it—this proves the third path truly exists and poses a threat to it.'"

"No matter which path he chose, Chen Ji emerged from the secret passage. Outside, the sky had begun to lighten with dawn. He stood at the cliff's edge, allowing the morning breeze to stir his robes, his mind repeatedly replaying the fourth page's contents. The fates of past prophets, the Eye of Heavenly Dao's gaze, the possibility of a third path... this information was like puzzle pieces, gradually forming a blurry yet grand picture in his mind. His existence itself was a variable—this was both crisis and opportunity. The Tianji Pavilion wanted this key, the Eye of Heavenly Dao wanted to erase him, and Chen Nian... his sister, the girl taken by the Holy Sect as a Heavenly Fate Lock Key, seemed to hold the key to the third path."

"Chen Ji lowered his gaze to his palm, where the burning pain from activating the fragment still lingered. He had consumed five points of Heavenly Fate—not much, but enough to alert him. The Tianji Record's abilities were not without cost; every glimpse of the future was a透支 of his own destiny. Now he faced an even harder choice: continue to lie low and wait for a better opportunity, or take the initiative to search for Chen Nian at the Holy Sect and uncover the truth of the third path? Morning light fell across his face, revealing deep, calm eyes. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, weakened, had withdrawn into the fragment and难得没有多话—for once, the choice was entirely Chen Ji's."

"In the distance, the Tianqing Sect Main Peak loomed indistinct in the morning mist. Chen Ji knew that Elder Ling Yuan must still be secretly watching his every move. And further away, Han Lie of the Xuanwu Sect, Ye Qing of the Demonic Path Holy Sect, the Observer of the Tianji Pavilion... all forces were wrestling on this chessboard. He, Chen Ji, once a废物 menial servant, now the greatest variable in the game. How ironic. A faint smile curved his lips, a meaning-laden arc. Since they all called him a chess piece, he would upend this entire game. The final line of the fourth page echoed in his mind: 'Apart from breaking the shackles and becoming a new Heavenly Dao, there exists a third path.' That path, he would find."

choice.prompt: "As the first rays of sunlight pierced through the clouds to bathe the earth, Chen Ji turned and walked toward the mountain below. His pace was calm and resolute, his silhouette stretching long in the morning light. That night, he had gained much and lost much—his Heavenly Fate had been consumed, his understanding of the Eye of Heavenly Dao had deepened, and his perception of this world had been completely overturned. But one thing remained unchanged: he would find Chen Nian, he would break this damned fate, he would carve out his own path. Behind him, the secret passage entrance slowly sealed shut, the little bird mark flickering one final time before fading completely. It had completed its mission, guiding the brother toward the first step of truth. The remaining path, Chen Ji would have to walk himself."

choices.text: "When Chen Ji stepped through the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, he came face to face with Su Qingyao. This Inner Disciple Senior Fellow's gaze lingered on him for a moment, her brow creasing slightly: 'Where were you last night?' Chen Ji lowered his eyes, his voice carrying appropriate fear: 'Replying to Senior Sister, Junior Brother merely went to the Rear Mountain to do odd jobs and accidentally got lost...' Su Qingyao coldly glanced at him, asked no further questions, and turned to leave. But Chen Ji noticed the backward glance as she departed—that look of scrutiny and suspicion was stronger than ever before. Alarm bells rang in his heart: it seemed this Inner Disciple Senior Fellow was getting closer to the truth by the day."

choices.text: "That night, Chen Ji transmitted a message to Ye Qing through the隐秘符文 inscribed within the fragment. After a moment, a cold voice rang in his mind: 'You've finally decided to contact me.' Chen Ji dispensed with pleasantries, asking directly: 'Chen Nian, the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, where is she in the Holy Sect?' Ye Qing fell silent for a moment, her voice carrying a hint of gravity: 'You know where she is?' Chen Ji's heart stirred: 'You know?' Ye Qing's answer made his pupils contract: 'She's in the core of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, being used as a sacrifice to suppress something... And her condition is not good. If you want to save her, you must act within three months—otherwise, she will be completely sacrificed.'"
choices.description: "Find the Tianji Pavilion Observer, press for the truth about the fourth page's key"

text.content: "The Tianji Pavilion's intentions are unclear; it may be another trap"

"Chen Ji tracked the residual aura left by the Observer, yet in a desolate mountain he discovered a message the Observer had left. A Jade Slip lay quietly on the rock, its surface engraved with four characters: '棋逢对手'. When Chen Ji picked up the Jade Slip, a stream of information flooded his mind—the Observer's神识: 'You and I share a common enemy. No need to rush. The third path is not in the book, not in the spirit, but beyond karma. Chen Nian... she knows more than you do.' The voice faded, and the Jade Slip crumbled to dust and dissipated. Chen Ji gripped the fragment tightly, his eyes flashing. Was this Observer friend or foe? What deeper meaning lay hidden in the information he revealed?"

"No matter which path he chose, Chen Ji understood one thing clearly: there was no going back. The manifestation of the fourth page had shown him his place in this world—not a chess piece to be maneuvered, but the hand that could overturn the chessboard. The Eye of Heavenly Dao watched from the shadows, the Tianji Pavilion schemed in the light, the Holy Sect imprisoned his sister, and within himself lay the Tianji Record Fragment capable of rewriting fate
